softwares.name: nginx
softwares.details: High-performance HTTP server and reverse proxy

softwares.name: Go
softwares.details: Install the Go toolchain (default 1.26.5), configure GOROOT/GOPATH, and install Air for live reloads.

softwares.name: Node.js
softwares.details: Install NVM (v0.40.5), the Node.js LTS release, and the latest pnpm package manager.

softwares.name: Docker Engine
softwares.details: Install Docker Engine static binaries, Buildx, and Compose, then start the dockerd service.

softwares.name: Google Chrome
softwares.details: Install Google Chrome (amd64) or Chromium (arm64) for apt/dnf hosts, with Desktop shortcuts for all users.

softwares.name: Visual Studio Code
softwares.details: Install Visual Studio Code (deb/rpm) with a container-safe launcher and Desktop shortcuts for all users.

softwares.name: VS Code Server
softwares.details: Install Microsoft's VS Code CLI and a codeserver helper (serve-web / tunnel) to open folders in the browser. See https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/remote/vscode-server

softwares.name: Cursor
softwares.details: Install Cursor AI code editor (deb preferred; AppImage extracted without FUSE) with a container-safe launcher and Desktop shortcuts for all users.

softwares.name: htop
softwares.details: Interactive process viewer for live CPU and memory per process. Useful from the shell when investigating load on this VM.

softwares.name: sysstat
softwares.details: System activity tools: mpstat (CPU), iostat (disk), and sar (history). Complements the live dashboard with CLI deep-dives.

softwares.name: iftop
softwares.details: Live network bandwidth monitor grouped by remote host. Use it from a shell when you need connection-level traffic detail beyond dashboard totals.

softwares.name: nvtop
softwares.details: Universal GPU process monitor (htop for graphics). Works across NVIDIA, AMD, Intel, and other DRM GPUs — utilization, VRAM, and per-process use.

softwares.name: intel-gpu-tools
softwares.details: Intel GPU utilities including intel_gpu_top for live engine utilization, frequency, and power on i915/Xe graphics. Best paired with an Intel GPU.

softwares.name: radeontop
softwares.details: Live AMD Radeon GPU utilization monitor. Shows graphics, memory, and shader activity for amdgpu/radeon devices from a shell.

softwares.name: gpustat
softwares.details: Pretty NVIDIA GPU status for the shell: utilization, memory, temperature, and power via nvidia-smi. Best on hosts with NVIDIA drivers.

softwares.name: Wireshark
softwares.details: GUI packet analyzer for live capture and deep protocol inspection. Kali desktop launcher for all users.

softwares.name: Zenmap
softwares.details: Official Nmap GUI for network discovery, port scans, and topology maps. Kali desktop launcher (zenmap-kbx when available).

softwares.name: EtherApe
softwares.details: Real-time graphical network traffic visualizer (node/link view). Desktop launcher for Kali containers.

softwares.name: Ettercap
softwares.details: Graphical sniffer/interceptor for switched LANs (MITM analysis). Kali desktop launcher via ettercap -G.

softwares.name: RustDesk
softwares.details: Install RustDesk remote desktop client with Desktop shortcuts for all users.

softwares.name: Rust
softwares.details: Install the Rust toolchain via rustup from https://rust-lang.org (rustc, cargo, rustup).
